title: Hello, Watchcraft!
summary: A short visual check of local playback and chapter seeking.

sections.title: Hello from local playback
sections.description: The blue opening confirms that Watchcraft loaded a video from the selected collection folder.

sections.title: Seek to green
sections.description: Selecting this chapter should move playback directly to the green section.

sections.title: Local playback complete
sections.description: The purple finish confirms seeking near the end of the local video.
